newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures slip below 21,000 points.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures slip below 21,000 points.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures slipped below key support at 21,000 points on Tuesday in what some dealers said was a technical correction but others called a reaction to worries over possible higher interest rates after the next Japanese election.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract settled 225 points lower at 20,975 on moderate volume of 15,195 lots.
"There are any number of possible expanations for the fall -- most credible -- but I think it was just a correction to the recent bullish phase," said one dealer.
Japan goes to the polls on October 20.
Technical analysts said the December contract was now within a new trading range of 20,550 to 21,000 points and would find immediate support in the middle of that range.
"We should find support at 20,800," said one analyst. "I think we'll try to get back above 21,000 tomorrow...but if it can't make it, the next direction will be down."
